NOT used as ground truth. Formula/mass reused from cisplatin (constitutional isomers, identical molecular formula CAS 14913-33-8), geometry (trans) authored per standard inorganic chemistry. THE SMILES STRING IS IDENTICAL TO CISPLATIN'S -- chematic currently has no square-planar stereo descriptor, so cis/trans cannot be distinguished in input; this identity_group pairing with cisplatin is the intended killer-benchmark probe for that exact gap (see FEASIBILITY.md).

Formula/mass used as ground truth (independently hand-derived from the CBDCA O,O-chelate structure below and matched exactly); connectivity authored here as cyclobutane-1,1-dicarboxylato(2-)-O,O' chelate + 2 dative NH3, matching the established CBDCA structure (CAS 41575-94-4).

PubChem lists this record's formula as 'C6H20Cl2N2O2Pt-4' with Charge=-4 -- internally inconsistent (2 free [OH-] + 2 free [Cl-] + neutral [Pt] atom + 2 neutral isopropylamine sums to -4, but real iproplatin is the well-documented NEUTRAL Pt(IV) complex cis,trans,cis-[PtCl2(OH)2(isopropylamine)2] (CHIP, CAS 62802-36-4), reached Phase II/III trials). Base atom-composition formula (C6H20Cl2N2O2Pt) and ExactMass are reused (charge-independent); charge corrected to 0 here with rationale stated. Connectivity authored per standard octahedral Pt(IV) geometry (2 dative isopropylamine, 2 covalent Cl, 2 covalent OH).

Real tetraplatin/ormaplatin is the well-documented NEUTRAL Pt(IV) complex [PtCl4(DACH)] (CAS 62816-98-2), a DACH-carrier Pt(IV) prodrug studied as an oxaliplatin-lineage analog. Base formula reused (matches independently); exact_mass_expected corrected to the RDKit-recomputed 448.954803, charge corrected to 0, both with rationale stated. Connectivity authored as DACH dative N,N-chelate + 4 covalent Cl.

This PubChem record IS internally consistent (Charge=0, all fragments balance). Formula/mass used as ground truth. Connectivity authored here as cisplatin's simplest axial-dihydroxo Pt(IV) prodrug (cis,trans-[PtCl2(OH)2(NH3)2], the parent scaffold satraplatin/iproplatin are built from), matching the requested 'cisplatin-derived Pt(IV) complex' category.

Dicycloplatin is a genuine 1:1 supramolecular adduct of carboplatin with free cyclobutane-1,1-dicarboxylic acid (CBDCA), approved in China (CAS 853298-31-6) -- unlike the cisplatin/carboplatin/etc. cases above, disconnection into 2 fragments here is chemically CORRECT, not a database artifact. Included deliberately as a contrast case: not every multi-fragment record is wrong. Formula/mass used as ground truth (independently hand-derived: carboplatin unit C6H12N2O4Pt + free CBDCA C6H8O4 = C12H20N2O8Pt, matched exactly).
